A little about me

Technology meets creativity.

I study Computer Science and Engineering at American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB). Alongside computing, I am passionate about music as a singer, composer and guitarist. I perform with bands including Kalponakkho and Oggato, and enjoy creating music as well as working behind the scenes in sound engineering, mixing and mastering. I also enjoy video editing, motion graphics, and exploring technology-related gadgets.
